column3: Type fractions using the slash or the fraction slash character and press backtick (`).
It will convert the numbers to Unicode superscript and subscript numbers with the fraction slash in between.
This is the only correct way of writing fractions in Unicode so that they look like ¹⁄₂ instead of 1⁄2.
For example 4⁵⁄₈ is the right way of writing fractions in Unicode.
